"""Freeze fixed quality,context-removal and native comparator design."""
import ast
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
previous=Path(plan['previous']);old=previous/'postprocess-v2/scripts';post=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts'
post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ['train_v43_quality_trial.py','report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py','profile_raw_kernel_inference.py',
             'report_checkpoint_pilot.py','train_directional_bank_trial.py']:
    shutil.copyfile(old/name,post/name)
for name in ['review_harmonic_context_trial.py','diagnose_harmonic_context_trial.py']:
    shutil.copyfile(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts'/name,post/name)
for name in ['score','audit','render']:
    text=(old/f'{name}_paired_response_trial.py').read_text().replace('_paired_response_trial','_harmonic_context_trial')
    text=text.replace('"plan-v2.json"','"plan-v1.json"').replace('"postprocess-plan-v2.json"','"postprocess-plan-v1.json"')
    text=text.replace('V160 ordinary and paired-response','V161 paired control and harmonic context')
    if name=='render':
        needle='names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","Ordinary raw1k","Ordinary EMA1k","Pair response raw1k","Pair response EMA1k"]'
        assert needle in text
        text=text.replace(needle,'names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","Pair ctrl raw1k","Pair ctrl EMA1k","Harmonic raw1k","Harmonic EMA1k"]')
        text=text.replace('V156 detail/V157 coarse/V158 quiet/V159 compromise','V156 detail/V157 coarse/V158 quiet/V159 compromise/V160 ordinary')
        text=text.replace('4 fixed V160 endpoints','4 fixed V161 endpoints')
    ast.parse(text);(post/f'{name}_harmonic_context_trial.py').write_text(text)
retained=read(previous/'postprocess-plan-v2.json')['retained_native_collections']
v160=read(previous/'review-result-v1.json')['collections']
retained={k:retained[k] for k in ['V156 raw retained','V157 EMA retained','V158 EMA retained','V159 EMA retained']}
retained['V160 ordinary EMA']=v160['ordinary-EMA-step1000']
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
for binding in retained.values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    collection=read(binding['path'])
    assert [r['id'] for r in collection['observations']]==[c['id'] for c in cases]
    assert all(r['parent']==c['parent'] for r,c in zip(collection['observations'],cases,strict=True))
save(root/'native-retained-comparators-v1.json',{'collections':retained,'new_forwards':0,
    'scope':'Five fixed retained columns:V156 raw,V157 EMA,V158 EMA,V159 EMA,V160 ordinary EMA. Current paired controls reproduce V160 paired raw/EMA. Same822 input/parent bindings;no extra calls for retained columns.'})
shared=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103'
metrics=[shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py',shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py',
    shared/'V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py']
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post,Path(plan['work'])/'scripts',Path(plan['work'])/'src']),
    OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
cmd='from pathlib import Path;from score_harmonic_context_trial import load_module;'
cmd+=f'r=Path({str(shared)!r});'
cmd+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");'
cmd+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py","independent_late_spectral_metrics");'
cmd+='load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
cmd+='import review_harmonic_context_trial,diagnose_harmonic_context_trial,audit_harmonic_context_trial,render_harmonic_context_trial;print("PASS actual primary/independent metrics,review,diagnostic and render imports")'
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',cmd],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'returncode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,'command':cmd,
    'metrics':[ref(p) for p in metrics],'retained_native_collections':retained,
    'sources':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},'new_neural_forwards':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(run.stdout.strip());print('Frozen10 postprocess sources/five retained columns/fixed12-case context-removal design')
